what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] validate_design_tmpdir_main initializes quiet logging before validating the candidate path
scenario_or_breakage: A wrapper with exported DESIGN_TMPDIR set to a disallowed existing directory can make quiet_init create larch-quiet-design-tmpdir-validate-<pid>.log under that directory before the validator rejects it, violating the no-write-before-allowlist contract
suggested_fix: Remove quiet_init from this validator-only verb, or move it after validation; emit failures directly to stderr without creating a quiet log
